主要内容: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. has proposed to acquire Rouse Properties, Inc. at a price of $17.00 per share. This acquisition is part of Brookfield's strategy to expand its real estate portfolio. The proposal was announced in a Form 6-K filing with the SEC on January 19, 2016. The filing indicates that Brookfield is seeking to enhance its position in the real estate sector through this acquisition. The details of the transaction, including the terms and conditions, are outlined in the exhibit provided with the filing. This move reflects the company's ongoing efforts to grow its assets and increase its market presence in the real estate industry.
